domain_policy: D_struct is the deliberate primary policy choice: high-coverage, provenance-safe, retaining all 28 predictors; it is not uniquely data-determined by the source audit
operational_estimand: species-specific relative response score over canonical cells in D_struct, conditional on the accepted presence/survey-supported-absence/pseudoabsence construction; not detection-corrected occupancy, abundance, population prevalence, or inference outside D_struct
pseudoabsence_post_domain_status: validated; rederivation not required; Goal025 defers per-species/fold adequacy
stop_boundary: before partitions, transformations, imputation, encoding, scaling, mapping, modelling
